mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quotation_context(work_order_id) VALUES(#{id}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE quotation_context SET version=version+1,basis_version=#{basisVersion},raw_quote_id=#{rawQuoteId,jdbcType=OTHER},formal_quote_id=#{formalQuoteId,jdbcType=OTHER},assessment_id=#{assessmentId,jdbcType=OTHER},insurer_confirmed=#{insurerConfirmed},service_confirmed=#{serviceConfirmed},authorized=#{authorized} WHERE work_order_id=#{workOrderId} AND version=#{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quote_raw_file(raw_quote_id,file_id) SELECT #{quote},f.id FROM case_file f WHERE f.work_order_id=#{caseId} AND f.category='SHOP_QUOTE' AND f.state='ACTIVE' AND f.shop_id=#{shop} AND f.assignment_version=#{assignment} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM audit_log a WHERE a.object_type='CASE_FILE' AND a.object_id=CAST(f.id AS text) AND a.action='FILE_UPLOAD' AND a.actor_id=f.uploaded_by AND 'REPAIR_SHOP'=ANY(string_to_array(a.actor_roles,','))) ORDER BY f.created_at,f.id LIMIT 20
mapper.select: SELECT f.id,f.original_name AS name,f.content_type FROM quote_raw_file r JOIN case_file f ON f.id=r.file_id WHERE r.raw_quote_id=#{id} ORDER BY f.created_at,f.id LIMIT 20
SELECT adopted_json FROM quote_formal_review WHERE formal_quote_id=#{id}
SELECT line_no,description,quantity,unit_price,amount,source_snapshot FROM quote_raw_item WHERE raw_quote_id=#{id} ORDER BY line_no LIMIT 1000

SELECT line_no,description,quantity,original_unit_price,original_amount,allocated_markup,external_unit_price,external_amount FROM quote_formal_item WHERE formal_quote_id=#{id} ORDER BY line_no LIMIT 1000

SELECT l.file_id,l.revision,r.candidate_json, (f.state='ACTIVE' AND f.id=(SELECT n.id FROM case_file n WHERE n.work_order_id=l.work_order_id AND n.category='LOSS_ASSESSMENT' AND n.state='ACTIVE' ORDER BY n.created_at DESC,n.id DESC LIMIT 1)) AS current_file FROM workflow_recognition_link l JOIN quote_assessment s ON s.id=l.business_id AND s.work_order_id=l.work_order_id JOIN case_file f ON f.id=l.file_id AND f.work_order_id=l.work_order_id AND f.category='LOSS_ASSESSMENT' JOIN ocr_review r ON r.job_id=l.job_id AND r.revision=l.revision JOIN ocr_confirmation c ON c.job_id=l.job_id AND c.revision=l.revision WHERE l.business_id=#{id} AND l.kind='ASSESSMENT'
SELECT id,version_no FROM case_file WHERE work_order_id=#{id} AND category='LOSS_ASSESSMENT' AND state='ACTIVE' ORDER BY id LIMIT 20
SELECT request_hash,response_json FROM quotation_command WHERE actor_id=#{actor} AND operation=#{operation} AND command_key=#{key}
SELECT * FROM WHERE ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
